title: Analista De Growth
description:
Planejar, executar e otimizar ações de geração de demanda orientadas por dados, garantindo fluxo previsível de leads inbound qualificados, aumento contínuo da conversão do funil e maior eficiência dos investimentos em marketing e growth.


Elevar de forma contínua o percentual de conversão das campanhas em visitas e reuniões comerciais, por meio da operação, análise e otimização de campanhas segmentadas, jornadas digitais e automações, assegurando geração previsível de leads inbound qualificados e redução de CAC.


Responsabilidades:

  • Operar campanhas de geração de demanda segmentadas por solução, segmento, unidade de negócio e região.
  • Gerenciar anúncios, landing pages, formulários e fluxos de comunicação associados às campanhas.
  • Acompanhar diariamente, no mínimo duas vezes ao dia, a performance e a conversão de cada campanha ativa.
  • Analisar indicadores de funil, conversão, custo por lead e custo por oportunidade.
  • Ajustar criativos, mensagens, cadências e abordagens com foco em aumento de conversão.
  • Otimizar a jornada do lead desde a entrada até o agendamento de reuniões comerciais.
  • Gerir automações de marketing, regras de tagueamento e integrações com CRM.
  • Consolidar relatórios semanais de performance, aprendizados e recomendações de otimização.
  • Apoiar a definição e execução de testes e hipóteses de growth.
  • Atuar em alinhamento contínuo com Inteligência de Mercado, SDR e Comercial, garantindo coerência entre campanhas, qualificação e abordagem comercial.
  • Contribuir para a redução de CAC e aumento da eficiência do investimento em mídia e campanhas.


Requisitos:

Experiência em marketing de performance, growth ou geração de demanda em ambientes B2B. Vivência em operação e otimização de campanhas digitais, análise de funil, conversão de leads em oportunidades, gestão de landing pages, formulários, automações de marketing e integração com CRM. Atuação orientada a dados, testes, métricas e melhoria contínua da conversão.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact;
transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .


With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films;
it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.


On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!


What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As our Marketing Specialist, you will lead the development and execution of growth strategies that position Peliplat as a must-try platform for film lovers.

You will create campaigns that spark curiosity, drive engagement, and fuel viral growth—leveraging influencers, community dynamics, and storytelling to scale our global presence.


Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute growth strategies to drive installs, engagement, and retention
  • Identify and scale viral loops, referral systems, and community-driven growth mechanisms
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Content teams to align growth initiatives

Campaign Development

  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution (e.G., “Watch With (Name),” themed screenings, launch campaigns)
  • Translate product features and content into compelling, user-facing narratives
  • Build campaigns that drive both immediate traction and long-term brand equity

Influencer & Partnership Strategy

  • Collaborate with influencers, creators, and partners to expand reach and credibility
  • Design and execute influencer programs and activation strategies
  • Identify high-potential creators and turn them into growth drivers for the platform

Performance & Optimization

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across key metrics (acquisition, engagement, retention)
  • Continuously test, iterate, and optimize campaigns based on data and insights


Who You Are

  • A builder mindset: you don’t just plan, you execute, test, and scale
  • Strong creative instinct paired with data-driven decision making
  • Deep interest in entertainment, culture, and digital communities
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and results-oriented


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in marketing, growth, or brand strategy
  • Proven track record of driving user acquisition and campaign performance
  • Experience in LATAM markets is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical, communication, and execution skills


Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in;

title: Marketing Manager
description:

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact;
transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .


With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films;
it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.


On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!


What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As Marketing Manager, Brazil , you will lead the development and execution of Peliplat’s local marketing strategy , driving user growth, engagement, and brand positioning in the Brazilian market.

This is a hands-on strategic role : you will not only execute campaigns but also define how Peliplat wins in Brazil —from influencer strategy and community growth to viral campaigns and cultural positioning.

You will work closely with global teams (Product, Content, BD) while acting as the local market expert , ensuring our product and messaging resonate deeply with Brazilian audiences.

title: Security Biso/Pmo
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Security BISO/PMO




Resumo:

O Security BISO/PMO atua como um elo estratégico entre as unidades de tecnologia, negócio e a organização de cibersegurança. Essa função garante que as iniciativas de segurança estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, enquanto gerencia a entrega de projetos de segurança em toda a empresa. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança, priorizar demandas de segurança e supervisionar planos e execução de projetos para reduzir riscos e impulsionar o crescimento do negócio.



Responsabilidades:

Alinhamento com o Negócio:

  • Servir como ponto de contato principal para as unidades de negócio em relação às necessidades e iniciativas de cibersegurança.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em estratégias e soluções de segurança acionáveis junto às demais equipes de cibersegurança.
  • Defender a segurança nos processos de negócio, garantindo conformidade com padrões regulatórios e organizacionais.

Gestão de Programas e Projetos:

  • Liderar e gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de segurança, garantindo entrega dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento.
  • Desenvolver e manter planos de projeto, registros de riscos e relatórios de status para as partes interessadas.
  • Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, incluindo TI, segurança e stakeholders de negócio, para atingir os objetivos dos projetos.

Governança e Relatórios:

  • Estabelecer e manter estruturas de governança para programas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas relacionadas às iniciativas de segurança.
  • Garantir alinhamento com requisitos de gestão de riscos corporativos e conformidade.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificar, avaliar e priorizar riscos de segurança que impactam as operações do negócio e alinhar com o registro de riscos do GRC.
  • Colaborar com líderes de negócio para implementar estratégias de mitigação de riscos.

Engajamento com Stakeholders:

  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com executivos, líderes de negócio e equipes técnicas.
  • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre postura de segurança, progresso dos projetos e ameaças emergentes.



Requisitos técnicos e experiência:

  • Graduação em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração de Empresas ou área relacionada.
  • Mais de 7 anos em funções de cibersegurança, gestão de riscos ou gestão de projetos de segurança.
  • Forte conhecimento de frameworks de cibersegurança (NIST, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Alta proficiência e experiência prática com metodologias de gestão de projetos, planejamento e entrega, como PMBOK e Agile.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar e interagir com stakeholders seniores.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ou produtos.
  • Conhecimento avançado das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de elaboração de relatórios para suporte à entrega de KPIs.
  • Fluência em inglês.



Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos ou gestão de produtos.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
    Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Brazil
description:
About Group-IB


Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses and citizens and support law enforcement operations.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.

Each of us can help make the world a safer place.

Join us!


The role:


As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.


This role is ideal for a motivated, self-starting sales professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets


Tasks to solve:


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Develops and implements sales strategies, manages sales pipelines, and monitors performance to achieve sales goals.
  • Team Leadership: Leads and motivates a sales team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and ensures customer satisfaction.
  • Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals.
  • Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM.
  • Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.


Qualifications


  • Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity.
  • Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Role-based in São Paulo.
  • Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team.
  • Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating.
  • Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans.
  • Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools


Why GROUP-IB?


  • Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy.
  • Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area.
  • Group-IB.A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? By choosing us, you will be choosing complex tasks and continuously improving your skills in a fast-growing international company.
  • Globally recognized technologies: Group-IB's members are located in 25 countries, and our products and services are sold in 60 countries. What’s more, Gartner, IDC, and Forrester have ranked our technologies among the best in their class. We work with over 450 international partners and about 500 clients.
  • A culture created by each of us: Group-IB’s employees speak many different languages and understand one another. We respect each other's beliefs, share common values, and strive toward the happiness of every employee.
  • Economic stability: Group-IB's sustainable growth helps rapidly develop careers that would take years to progress as far as most other companies.


What else should you know:


  • Flexible schedule: Group-IB does not have fixed working hours. You choose your schedule. We adhere to the principle advocated by Steve Jobs: “We have to work not 12 hours and head. ”Health: If anything goes wrong, don’t worry — we offer health insurance.
  • Certificates and training courses : Group-IB specialists hold over 1,000 professional certificates, including CEH, CISSP, OSCP, GIAC, MCFE, BSI, as well as some rare ones that would be a source of pride for experts in forensics, penetration testing, and reverse engineering worldwide. We have an incentive program that helps employees achieve certifications at the company's expense.
  • Challenges: A wide selection of GIB programs helps you improve soft skills, gain new competencies, and receive monetary rewards.
  • The initiative is rewarded: At Group-IB, you can bring your most daring ideas to life. The company encourages technical blogging, writing articles, building sports teams, and other creative activities.

Fortalecer, consolidar e expandir o processo de gestão de vulnerabilidade em clientes estratégicos da Hakai de alta relevância no mercado por meio de uma atuação consultiva, orientada por dados, excelência operacional e resultados sustentáveis.

title: Mobile Qa Engineer
description:
Mobile QA Engineer

Location: LATAM


Looking for a talented and motivated Quality Test Engineer to contribute to the mission of helping the world’s farmers sustainably increase productivity using digital tools, mobile software, advanced analytics and high quality assurance standards. This role is a unique opportunity to join our dynamic Brazil laboratory, responsible for testing the web & mobile apps that will operate under extreme environments and help ensure a great experience for our customers.


You will work on creating Test Plans and Test Cases and in most cases performing the manual testing based on those Test Plans and Test Cases. You will ensure our applications are accurate, robust, scalable, performant and deployable, and will have the opportunity to work with large, "big data" sets such as scientific data, machine generated data from our farmer's equipment to geospatial data, precision agriculture, remote sensing, weather and soil data. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering and business partners to enable a seamless, high-quality experience for our customers.


What You Will Do:

  • Pair up with software engineers, product owners and test engineers to deliver manual test suites to validate our web and mobile (iOS, Android) applications
  • Test our applications with different locales to guarantee a valuable global product experience to our customers, going to the field when necessary
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers to ensure the data and software tools they use are accurate and reliable
  • Write up test strategies, test plans, design documents, and whatever else may be needed
  • Actively engage in root cause analysis reviews
  • Assist in ongoing process improvement efforts to ensure test planning, execution, and reporting is effective and efficient
  • Create detailed incident reports for production issues, and work on triage and investigation
  • Be willing to take on other responsibilities and tackle a variety of engineering and testing problems - we are a small team and all share role
  • Be willing to be a representative of the QA team on a project and lead all test activities that are needed



Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience
  • Strong self-starter who will work closely and daily with an existing team of other self-starters
  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may be accepted
  • Nice to have: Agriculture degree with QA knowledge and experience
  • Understanding the SDLC and the tester role and responsibility within it
  • You understand deadlines and the need to deliver the most valuable things first
  • English fluency
  • You will communicate with US based teams on a daily basis and bridge any communication gaps between English and non-English team members
  • at least B2 level of English, Cambridge or similar certification is a Plus
  • Understanding of common user interface design patterns and software quality assurance methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile teams, experience in SAFe is a Plus


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with blackbox testing
  • Strong experience with web
  • Medium experience with mobile and API testing
  • ISTQB certification is a Plus
  • basic programmer knowledge is a Plus


We also hinge our cultural DNA on these five values:

  • Inspire one another
  • Innovate in all we do
  • Leave a mark on the world
  • Find the possible in the impossible
  • Be direct and transparent

title: Analista De Segurança Da Informação Sênior
description:

Então essa é a sua chance!

O cargo garante o cumprimento de todos os requisitos de auditoria e regulamentação externos e internos, sendo responsável por identificar e gerenciar riscos e controles para proteger a confidencialidade, disponibilidade e integridade dos dados da Fifty5Blue/Ibope.

  • Apoiar áreas de negócios e tecnologia na identificação, registro, categorização e priorização de riscos de segurança.
  • Gerir e manter o Registro de Riscos e monitore o ciclo de vida do tratamento até o fechamento.
  • Apoiar a definição da nova solução de gestão de riscos .
  • Apoiar a integração da gestão de riscos de segurança no processo corporativo de gestão de riscos .
  • Definir e monitorar os principais indicadores de risco (KRIs) e os principais indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) .
  • Planejar, implementar e manter o Plano de Continuidade de Negócios (BCP) e o Plano de Recuperação de Desastres (DRP) .

  • Liderar ou apoiar testes e simulações de continuidade e recuperação (exercícios de mesa, testes de failover, etc.) .
  • Suporte na certificação ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 .

  • Desenvolver e revisar políticas, padrões, procedimentos e modelos gerais .

  • Ajudar a manter a conformidade com diretrizes internas, bem como com leis e regulamentos externos .

  • Experiência de mais de 6 anos em Segurança da Informação / Cibersegurança .
  • Experiência em gestão de riscos de segurança da informação .
  • Experiência em continuidade de negócios .
  • Boa comunicação, habilidades de influência e alta atenção aos detalhes .
  • Desenvolver e manter bons relacionamentos de trabalho com partes interessadas, colegas e parceiros de negócios .

Essencial

  • Inglês avançado .
  • Proficiente em Microsoft Excel, Word e PowerPoint.
  • Conhecimento sobre estruturas de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, leis e regulamentos, como ISO 27001/27002/27005/22301, COSO, DRI, NIST, LGPD, GDPR, etc.



Desejável

  • Certificações em segurança da informação, gestão de riscos e continuidade de negócios .
  • Conhecimento em Power BI .
  • Espanhol Intermediário.



O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

  • Convênio Farmácia

  • Convênio com empresas parceiras

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

description:

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.G., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and workflows effectively, including AI-enabled automation, agent-based ways of working, etc.
  • Passion for Gaming: Active gamer with a genuine interest in gaming culture and content.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
  • Tools: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, and structured data handling.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

  • Retenção, descarte e ciclo de vida dos dados (Regras de retenção, descarte seguro e conformidade regulatória).

  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar informações complexas de forma objetiva.
  • Postura consultiva e senso de priorização de riscos.

title: Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist
description:
Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist


Overview

The Specialist, Information Security - Forensics is part of a global team and is responsible for incident response of cyber security incidents that are associated with our businesses, clients, and vendors;
is technically skilled and ensures incident containment, remediation, and closure. This individual will be expected to work closely with the legal, data privacy, business, and client teams. They should be comfortable with interacting with senior executives, including C-level staff.


Responsibilities:

Incident Leadership

  • Serve as the Incident Commander, leading the full lifecycle of cybersecurity incident investigations and response efforts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional communication during high-severity incidents, ensuring rapid containment and clarity across teams.
  • Present concise, accurate written and oral reports to executive and operational leadership.

Forensic Analysis & Investigation

  • Analyze compromised or potentially compromised systems using advanced forensic tools and methodologies.
  • Conduct complex forensic investigations into system breaches, data leaks, and architectural weaknesses.
  • Coordinate evidence and data collection to ensure thorough and reliable incident documentation.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare detailed security incident reports that transform technical findings into actionable insights for decision-makers.
  • Document investigation steps, timelines, technical observations, and remediation impacts with precision and clarity.

Threat Intelligence & Continuous Learning

  • Maintain current knowledge of attacker TTPs, advanced persistent threats, emerging tools, and incident response best practices.
  • Apply threat intelligence insights to strengthen investigative techniques and enhance incident detection capabilities.

Technical Guidance & Support

  • Provide expert technical guidance to teams on incident monitoring, triage, response workflows, threat and vulnerability management, and security analysis.
  • Mentor team members and support growth in incident response competencies across the organization.

Process Optimization & Strategic Direction

  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve incident management efficiency and response workflows at scale.
  • Champion the integration of automation and AI-driven tools to accelerate detection, triage, and resolution.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of the company’s cybersecurity and incident response programs.


Qualifications:

  • EDR Experience- CrowdStrike and/or SentinelOne with experience investigating and analyzing malware and other malicious activity.
  • Experience with forensics tools such as FTK, EnCase, Autopsy to collect and analyze file system artifacts, process history, application artifacts, memory collection and analysis for physical and cloud systems (Windows, Mac, Linux).
  • 4 or more years of experience in an analytical role of either forensics analyst (Linux, Windows, or MacOS), threat analyst, incident response, SOC analyst, or security engineer/ consultant.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as: Azure, AWS, GCP – knowing how to collect and analyze logs from Guard Duty/ Defender and CloudTrail, etc.
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK or related frameworks.
  • Experience developing and managing incident response programs with focus on efficiency through AI development.
  • Strong communication skills with confidence leading Incident Response calls with different stakeholders;
    followed by producing detailed incident reports.
  • Proficient insocial engineering, phishing, and related fraud schemes.
  • Strong general knowledge of security concepts and expertise in network and web application security issue s.
  • Experience with a scripting language such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other scripting language in an incident handling environment.

title: Sap Grc Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.


Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.


In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.


Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.


What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Qa Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em uma empresa do segmento de Agronegócio , que está estruturando uma nova área de tecnologia, com forte foco em SAP S/4HANA , processos críticos de negócio e transformação digital.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Apoiar na estruturação da área de QA, ajudando a definir processos, padrões e boas práticas
  • Executar testes manuais e apoiar na evolução de automações
  • Validar fluxos de negócio (originação de grãos, logística e financeiro) garantindo qualidade das entregas
  • Atuar em testes funcionais, integrados (SIT) e de aceitação (UAT)
  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar bugs
  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar na organização de evidências e documentação de testes


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com processos de QA (planejamento, execução e gestão de bugs)
  • Vivência com testes manuais e automatizados, com contato em automação de testes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex.: Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, CBTA ou similares)
  • Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Newman, Rest Assured, Swagger ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de teste (SIT, UAT e Regressão)
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de testes (Jira, SAP Cloud ALM, Azure DevOps ou similares)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com automação utilizando Python (Pytest, Robot Framework).
  • Familiaridade com uso de IA no desenvolvimento de testes (GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
  • Conhecimento em módulos SAP (ACM, SD, MM, FI, TM).
  • Vivência com metodologia SAP Activate.
  • Experiência no setor de Agronegócio ou Logística Multimodal será considerada um diferencial.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial

title: Engenheiro De Fpga - Sistemas De Telecomunicações
description:
A AEL está em busca de um profissional dinâmico, técnico e comprometido, com forte capacidade de trabalho em equipe e atuação em desafios complexos envolvendo desenvolvimento de lógica programável em FPGAs para modem. Este profissional aplicará conhecimentos em linguagens de descrição de hardware (VHDL), simulações RTL, comunicação digital e analógica, atuando em um ambiente de excelência, inovador e multicultural.


Nessa posição você terá o desafio de

  • Desenvolver e otimizar projetos de lógica programável para FPGA, assegurando performance, estabilidade e aderência aos requisitos técnicos.
  • Criar e validar testbenches e simulações RTL, garantindo alta confiabilidade nas funcionalidades implementadas.
  • Integrar sistemas embarcados complexos (FPGA/GPP/DSP), solucionando questões de compatibilidade e desempenho.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ou de Computação
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de lógica programável para FPGA (desejável para família Xilinx)
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de descrição de hardware (VHDL), testbenches e simulações RTL
  • Familiaridade com design baseado em SoC
  • Conhecimento em comunicação analógica e digital por rádio
  • Compreensão de técnicas de modem e experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com integrações de sistemas embarcados (FPGA/GPP/DSP)
  • Experiência em ferramentas de simulação (MATLAB)


O que a AEL te proporciona

  • Política de horários flexível e modelo híbrido: Atuamos com banco de horas e alguns dias de atuação remota, proporcionando uma rotina flexível
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Custos de adesão subsidiados pela AEL
  • Seguro de Vida: Zelamos pela sua proteção e de seus familiares
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefícios Flash e contamos com refeitório na empresa
  • Auxílio Mobilidade/Vale Transporte: Facilitamos o seu deslocamento diário com opções que se adaptam à sua rotina
  • Estimulamos o equilíbrio da vida pessoal e profissional: Temos um calendário anual de feriados e férias coletivas, visando estimular o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional
  • Celebramos nossas conquistas: temos diversas ações de confraternização e reconhecimento, celebrando os atingimentos da jornada
  • Auxílio idioma: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento através do aprimoramento em inglês

  • Incentivos à prática de atividades físicas: Investimos na sua saúde através de grupos de corrida, ginástica funcional e ginástica laboral
  • Bebê AEL: Celebramos a chegada de novos membros das famílias
  • Empresa Cidadã: Contamos com dias estendidos de licença maternidade e paternidade


Sobre a AEL Sistemas

Excelência faz parte da nossa cultura. Está em tudo o que fazemos, nos processos, na forma de ser e inovar. A cada dia, o nosso potencial criativo se materializa na tecnologia de ponta que desenvolvemos. Aqui valorizamos as relações humanas, amigáveis e plurais, identificando os momentos em que é preciso seguir a formalidade e reforçar a nossa experiência.


Somos uma empresa genuinamente brasileira. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Analista De Banco De Dados Oracle
description:
FAÇA PARTE DE UM TIME MOVIDO PELA EVOLUÇÃO!

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Sap S/4hana Security & Authorisation Manager
description:
SAP S/4HANA Security and Authorisation Manager | Digital Core

Locations: Sao Paolo, Brazil - Hyderabad, India


As we work to transform and optimise Mars, a new program has been mobilised by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonisation scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program focuses primarily on eight mega process areas: Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfil (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (sales order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This transformation requires thought leadership, quality decision making, deep technical know-how, and an ability to navigate complex business challenges while applying a holistic and multi-disciplinary approach to each of these mega processes.

As part of the program, four new positions have been created to manage all core Security and Compliance activities related to the SAP S/4HANA landscape.

Collectively the new roles will be responsible for the delivery of the core SAP Security deliverables within S/4HANA and FIORI ensuring alignment with role design, processes and governance principles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. personally and within the team.
  • Support the SAP Security team in ensuring that shared and local / segment template security requirements are adopted across business segments while incorporating segment-specific needs into the shared template or localising them as necessary.
  • Analyse and understand the security requirements and risks of a complex ERP environment that underpins critical business and IT processes.
  • Work with the SAP Security team and Global Process Owners (GPO’s) in implementing a comprehensive SAP Security and GRC framework, including strategies, policies, and procedures that align with organisational objectives and industry best practices to ensure robust access controls, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and deliver technical and functional solutions against specifications in accordance with agreed standards and procedures.
  • Follow standards and procedure for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and segregation of duties.
  • Lead and support multiple testing phases – including build unit tests (BUT) security unit tests (SUT) system integration tests (SIT) and user acceptance tests (UAT) by leveraging Mars current test tools to ensure robust SAP security and system integrity.
  • Collaborate effectively within a diverse team that fosters an inclusive culture, ensuring all contributions are valued and recognised.
  • Stay informed on emerging security threats and apply industry best practices to strengthen SAP application security and controls.


Context and Scope

Programs are often marked by a seamless transition from the old system/landscape to the new one. As part of this SAP S/4HANA Digital Transformation program, we require someone with high-level expertise and experience in SAP Security & Authorisations in S/4HANA including FIORI.

The successful candidate will support the delivery of the security scope and collaborate with counterparts at Mars (i.E. Petcare, Corporate, Snacking and Food) to capture and analyse authorisation requirements and security related activities.



Education and Professional

  • 10+ years in SAP Security and Authorisations with at least three full life cycle implementations in S/4HANA and FIORI.
  • Professional certification such as SAP Certified Technology Professional, SAP Access Control 12.0, or other relevant security certifications.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA security and authorisations including role design administration and integration with FIORI.
  • Proficiency in security design, configuration, testing and deployment across key technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori and SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).
  • Strong understanding of authorisation concepts for S/4 HANA including FIORI, Business Technology Platform (BTP) and other Cloud applications such SuccessFactors, Ariba, & SAP MDG.
  • Deep knowledge of SOX compliance, segregation of duties (SoD), GDPR, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent understanding of S/4HANA product roadmap.
  • Highly organised with proven experience in setting and managing deadlines across diverse stakeholder groups while ensuring clear ownership and accountability for all activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong team player mindset with a drive to develop new professional skills combined with proactive, growth oriented and goal-focused approach to work.
  • Excellent documentation, visualisation and presentation skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft office tools particularly PowerPoint and Excel with expertise in building complex formulas, developing pivot tables and creating data-driven reports and presentations.
  • Experience working with System and Business Integrators.
  • Ability to work under pressure and maintain a professional manner.


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Paid Social Marketing Specialist
description:
There will be a strategy and data analysis assessment project as a part of the recruiting process.


We are looking for a Paid Social Marketing Specialist to join our Accounts Team, supporting the management and optimization of advertising campaigns for high-growth Direct-to-Consumer e-commerce brands.


In this role, you will focus on the hands-on execution of campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Snap, ensuring daily performance aligns with ROAS, CPA, and CAC objectives.


Reporting to the Director of Accounts, you will work to maintain, adjust, and enhance campaign performance. Additional experience with Paid Search platforms and strategies such as Google and Bing will be considered a valuable skillset.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute, monitor, and optimize Paid Social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Snap
  • Implement audience targeting, creative placement, and bidding strategies
  • Apply tracking templates, URL parameters, and conversion tracking to ensure accurate performance measurement
  • Manage campaign budgets, pacing, and performance against client's Source-of-Truth goals
  • Prepare performance reports and provide supporting analysis for internal strategy discussions.
  • Stay informed of platform updates, new tools, and emerging best practices to apply in execution.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on Paid Social account management (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snap)
  • Proven success working on non-brand e-commerce campaigns optimizing for ROAS, CPA, and CAC
  • Experience managing at least 3 e-commerce accounts with monthly ad spend exceeding USD $50,000 each
  • Advanced knowledge of Paid Social campaign tracking and attribution
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Shopify analytics and optimization using 1st-party data
  • Strong ad copywriting skills with a focus on conversion
  • Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) principles
  • Ability to work with creative teams to implement effective Paid Social creative strategies
  • Previous agency experience (preferred but not required).
  • Experience with Paid Search (Google and Bing)


Additional Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • Dedicated work computer and professional, quiet work environment
  • Legal work status in Brazil


Compensation starts at USD $2,200 / month based on experience, 10 PTO Days + 5 Sick Days + Federal Brazilian Holidays + Bonus potential

title: Especialista De Arquitetura E Implantação | Expansão
description:
Descrição da vaga

No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias.


Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.


Buscamos um perfil estratégico e multidisciplinar para atuar no coração da expansão do Grupo F&L. Você será responsável por gerenciar a arquitetura e a implantação de lojas para diversas marcas do portfólio, garantindo que cada conceito criativo seja traduzido em espaços viáveis, rentáveis e escaláveis. É uma posição de alta visibilidade, que exige trânsito entre o criativo e o financeiro, com foco em excelência operacional.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolvimento de Conceito Multimarca: Colaborar com os times criativos de cada marca (Reserva, Sprint, Oficina, etc.) para refinar conceitos arquitetônicos, garantindo que a execução seja fiel ao DNA de cada marca e economicamente viável.
  • Engenharia de Valor e Escalabilidade: Analisar criticamente os projetos para garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis (rollout), definindo padrões técnicos que otimizem prazos e custos sem comprometer a estética.
  • Gestão de Implantação e Obras: Liderar o ciclo completo de obras e reformas de todo o portfólio do grupo, do planejamento inicial à entrega das chaves.
  • Interface Estratégica com Administradoras: Atuar como interlocutor técnico sênior junto aos grandes players de shopping (Multiplan, Allos, Ancar, etc. ), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação.
  • Gestão de CAPEX e Parceiros: Equalizar orçamentos, realizar a precificação junto a parceiros estratégicos e garantir que cada inauguração respeite as metas financeiras do Grupo.
  • Homologação e Fiscalização: Selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e empreiteiras, realizando visitas técnicas para garantir a qualidade de entrega e o cumprimento dos cronogramas.
  • Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo (preferencial) ou Engenharia Civil.
  • Experiência: Sólida bagagem em implantação de varejo, preferencialmente com experiência em gestão de múltiplas marcas simultâneas.
  • Bagagem de Mercado: Experiência em marcas que são referências em conceito e experiência de loja ou em grandes administradoras de shoppings é um diferencial importante.
  • Soft Skills Inegociáveis: * Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para escrever e falar com clareza, influenciando parceiros externos e reportando resultados para a liderança.
  • Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil "dono do negócio", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra.
  • Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo.
  • Ferramentas: Domínio de AutoCad e Pacote Office (Excel avançado para controle de CAPEX).
  • Mobilidade: Residir no Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para viagens.


Informações adicionais


NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS

No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história.


Saúde e bem estar


- Plano de saúde

- Plano odontológico

- Seguro de vida

- Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou TotalPass

- Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental


Dia a dia e qualidade de vida


- Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash

- Vale transporte

- Day off de aniversário

- Extensão de licença maternidade

- Extensão de licença paternidade

- Descontos nas marcas do grupo


Desenvolvimento e crescimento


- Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento

- Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas

- Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento


Reconhecimento


- Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente



* Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia.

title: Analista De Segurança Da Informação Sênior
description:
Somos a SPIC Brasil. Geramos energia renovável para mover o país.


Procuramos uma pessoa colaborativa, curiosa e com visão inovadora para nos ajudar a potencializar a energia do Brasil e a transformar o setor global de energia elétrica. Você será a voz do cliente dentro da construção da SPIC Brasil, traduzindo as demandas em ações e projetos de forma ágil e simples.

Seguimos determinados em nossa trajetória de crescimento em energia renovável que gere competitividade ao país, novas e ampliadas oportunidades para nossos colaboradores, respeito ao meio ambiente e a saúde e segurança das nossas pessoas e parceria com as comunidades em que atuamos.

Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo profissionais PCDs.


Descrição da vaga:

Atuar como responsável técnico principal e referência em Segurança da Informação da companhia, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais, a continuidade do negócio, a integridade das informações e a aderência às melhores práticas de mercado, por meio da definição, implementação, operação e evolução contínua dos controles de segurança cibernética.


Atividades:


  • Assegurar a proteção integral dos ativos de informação da companhia.
  • Operar, monitorar e evoluir os controles técnicos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Gerenciar riscos cibernéticos em ambientes de TI e OT.
  • Garantir resposta efetiva a incidentes de Segurança da Informação.
  • Assegurar gestão eficaz de identidades e acessos.
  • Garantir conformidade, governança e aderência às boas práticas.
  • Atuar com autonomia técnica e apoio à tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Garantir visibilidade, controle e previsibilidade da postura de segurança.
  • Gerir tecnicamente fornecedores, contratos e orçamento de segurança.



Requisitos:

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Especialização em Segurança da Informação ou MBA em Segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento em Azure e Microsoft On-Premise, Cloud AWS e Huawei, Redes, Firewall, VPN, VLAN,SIEM (Splunk), EDR / XDR (CrowdStrike), IAM / PAM, Segurança de aplicações (OWASP).
  • Experiência com Integração SSO via SAML, SASE/CASB (Netskope). MDM (Intune), Email Security (Proofpoint), Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Qualys (TI) e Claroty (OT), Sharepoint e ferramentas de colaboração - O365.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
About us

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.


We are seeking a strategic User Acquisition expert to drive performance-led growth across our mobile ecosystem in LATAM. This role owns the end-to-end paid acquisition strategy, from planning and executing campaigns across major ad networks to scaling what works through rigorous experimentation and optimization. Leveraging deep expertise in mobile attribution, creative testing, and growth channels, you will play a critical role in accelerating sustainable user growth as we continue building our super app across multiple markets.


Please submit your resume in English. Otherwise, your application will be dismissed.



Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute user acquisition strategies across major paid channels (Google, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, etc.).
  • Manage and optimize large advertising budgets to maximize ROI and maintain strong CAC performance.
  • Partner closely with analytics, product, and creative teams to improve funnel performance and post-install metrics.
  • Own and scale creative testing pipelines, expanding top-performing assets while ensuring brand consistency.
  • Evaluate and pilot new user acquisition channels, technologies, and measurement frameworks to improve efficiency and scale.
  • Lead and scale digital growth initiatives across multiple user acquisition channels and markets.
  • Build, manage, and optimize performance marketing campaigns to drive sustainable, data-driven user growth.
  • Own large paid media budgets, ensuring strong ROI and CAC through continuous experimentation and optimization.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in user acquisition or performance marketing, preferably for mobile products.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Deep understanding of MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular) and attribution models (CTIT, re-attribution, SRNs, etc.).
  • Proven experience managing large paid budgets and optimizing campaigns toward ROI/CAC goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build hypotheses, run experiments, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  • Solid understanding of creative testing, audience segmentation, and conversion rate optimization.


We offer:

  • Competitive compensation package including comprehensive medical insurance coverage.
  • Meal allowance
  • Embrace the opportunity to make an impact in a pivotal branch within the region, tackling significant security challenges while unlocking great potential for growth and impact.
  • Dental Insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

title: Latam Marketing Manager
description:
BSI’s Assurance division is hiring a LATAM Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy across Latin America with a primary focus on Mexico.

In this role, you will translate global strategy into high-impact, localized programs that fuel pipeline and revenue across System Certification, Training, and ISA, while leading our regional Center of Excellence (CoE) for campaign development, design, and digital execution.

You’ll also serve regionally as a Theme Lead for Quality & Mobility, setting the bar for messaging and integrated campaigns used across the Americas.

If you thrive in a matrixed, fast-paced environment and can flex from strategy to hands-on execution, this role is for you!


What you’ll own:

  • LatAm GTM leadership: Build and deliver the marketing plan for Latin America (with Mexico emphasis) aligned to commercial targets and sector priorities.
  • Localization that wins: Adapt global/regional campaigns to local language, culture, regulation, and buyer behavior.
  • Partner with the business: Collaborate effectively with Sales and Training to shape marketing strategies that move pipeline and revenue.


How you’ll lead:

  • Operational excellence: Drive clarity, workload management, and accountability using project tools (e.G., Workfront);
    uphold brand, compliance, and governance standards.


How you’ll execute:

  • Full-funnel, integrated campaigns: Orchestrate email, web, SEO/SEM, paid media, social, events/webinars, and ABM to create demand and accelerate conversions.
  • Digital & demand-gen mastery: Increase engagement, improve targeting, and optimize journeys;
    manage lead workflows in Salesforce and Pardot (segmentation, routing, nurture).
  • Budget ownership: Plan, allocate, and track the LATAM marketing budget for maximum ROI.
  • Vendor leadership: Manage local partners (design, translation, event logistics, media buying) to deliver on brief, on brand, on budget.
  • Brand & governance: Ensure every asset meets BSI’s standards and regional regulatory requirements.


How you’ll measure success:

  • Performance & analytics: Track KPIs and attribution, maintain CRM hygiene, and partner with data teams on ROI reporting.
  • Optimize in real time: Use funnel insights to test, learn, and iterate maximizing conversion and marketing-influenced revenue.


Regional Theme Leadership (Quality & Mobility):

  • Set the bar regionally: Define positioning, content strategy, and integrated campaigns for Quality & Mobility.
  • Scale best practices: Align global messaging with LATAM needs;
    enable knowledge-sharing and consistent activation across countries.


What you bring:

  • Strategic clarity & executional rigor: You turn business goals into actionable programs that deliver measurable impact.
  • Proven demand gen: History of campaigns that drive MQLs, pipeline, and conversion in complex B2B environments.
  • LATAM expertise: Deep understanding of Mexico and broader LATAM buyer behavior, channels, and regulatory nuances.
  • Localization mastery: You have experience in tailoring global content/messages for maximum regional relevance.
  • Relationship builder: Confident collaborator across Sales, Training, and global teams.
  • Operational savvy: Budget management, vendor oversight, and performance reporting are second nature.
  • Martech fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce and Pardot (required);
    familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, SEO/SEM, paid media, and ABM tactics.
  • Organized & adaptable: Comfortable switching from big-picture strategy to precise execution;
    continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Segment & persona chops: You tailor narratives and offers by industry, role, and stage to move deals forward.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 6+ years progressive B2B marketing experience (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries ideal), including 3+ years leading people.
  • Proven experience executing marketing across Mexico and broader LATAM.
  • Success running multi-channel GTM in a complex organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop marketing professionals and foster cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong digital demand gen/ABM background and CRM-led workflows (Salesforce/Pardot required).
  • Familiarity with ISO, assurance, training, or compliance services (preferred).
  • Knowledge of Quality or Mobility sectors (preferred).


Language Requirements

A strong command of English, Spanish, and Portuguese is essential - both verbal and written. Please submit your application in English.


BSI - Your Partner in Progress

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organizations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team then please apply now!


What we offer

BSI offers a competitive salary, 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, vacation bonus, medical insurance, life insurance, savings fund with company contribution, meal allowance, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization — all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA


ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.


About the Job


ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.


This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.


Key Responsibilities


Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development


  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.


Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution


  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.


Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management


  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.


Project Oversight & Value Realization


  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.


What You’ll Need


Experience


  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.


Network & Market Knowledge


  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.


Territory Management


  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.


Languages


  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.


Commercial & Strategic Skills


  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.


Remote Collaboration


  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.


Travel


  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.


Why Join us?


  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.


*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.
